thumbnail_brief: Top-down view of 7-9 grey sperm whales in a ring on dark-blue water, heads together and tails out like daisy petals, tiny Doug in a grey sperm whale calf costume (cap on top) in the middle, 4-6 black orca fins outside the ring; no blood or wounds, and nothing implying the whales win.
description:
When orcas come to kill, sperm whales don't dive away. They form a circle at the surface, heads together and tails out, with the young and the hurt in the middle. Doug squeezes into the marguerite in a sperm whale calf costume, from the babysitting shifts to the 1997 attack scientists watched for four hours off California.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe and watch Doug's death counter keep climbing.
